notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You have a way to give Raptor Hatchling indestructible.
description:
Give Raptor Hatchling indestructible, if needed.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have that creature deal damage equal to its power to Raptor Hatchling.
Raptor Hatchling triggers, causing you to create a 3/3 Dinosaur creature token.
When the Dinosaur enters the battlefield, Halana triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Dinosaur, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Halana trigger, causing you to pay {2} to deal 1 damage to Raptor Hatchling.
Repeat from step 4.
